bio: Ballathie Country House Hotel and Estate is situated on the banks of the River Tay in Perthshire, in the heart of Scotland. Perth is on our doorstep, Dundee and St Andrews less than an hour away, Glasgow, Edinburgh, Inverness and Aberdeen within easy reach.  Enjoy Afternoon Tea in the comfort of the Drawing Room overlooking the lawns and river which includes delicate sandwiches, freshly-baked scones, cakes and a selection of teas and coffee.
